newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Polygram rises in New York.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Polygram rises in New York.

text.p: Shares in Dutch music publisher Polygram NV rose on Monday to highlight quiet trade in foreign shares and American Depositary Receipts (ADRs).
Polygram rose 1-1/8 to 45-3/8 in moderate volume, boosted by buy programs on the Amsterdam exchange, a trader said.
He added, "Having been very active the last two, three weeks, (trade in foreign shares) is very quiet this morning."
Among Japanese stocks, semiconductor component maker Kyocera Corp fell 7-1/8 to 110-3/8 in relatively heavy trade after it cut its parent sales forecast for 1996-97.
Brazilian telecommunications holding Telebras rose one to 85-5/8 and was among the most heavily traded ADRs.
Decliners led advancers by 271 to 219 in an 807-ADR index. Volume was 29.2 million shares.
